coverage: The current rendered Food page contains 146 regenerative rows and 42 separately listed non-regenerative items. Every regenerative row is reconciled to its own current item-page revision. The duration packet now contains 140 existing-native-ID records and six explicitly source-only records (four IDs absent from native definitions and two multi-state cake pages). 143 numeric nutrition durations are retained as DERIVED source data; three current ? values remain UNKNOWN. Five ordinary foods were spot-checked from an explicit hungry baseline using one item and a fresh official Food tooltip: brown mushroom 264 s, blueberry 12 s, cherry 12 s, raspberry 12 s, banana 96 s. These five checks agree with Wiki; no other row is claimed individually measured. The 42 non-regenerative names are retained separately without inventing zero-duration values. HP/MP regeneration rates, the food cap and other behaviour-sensitive formulas retain their existing evidence holds. No original binary, screenshot, character identity or balance is published.
